channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rudy Tomjanovich | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rudy Tomjanovich from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Mark Berman:Clyde Drexler on Rudy Tomjanovich joining him in the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame (@Hoophall):

“Finally, Rudy T gets in the Hall of Fame. He gets his just due as a coach. He could’ve been in as a player as well. He was a phenomenal player. Rudy’s a great guy...”

Clyde Drexler on Rudy Tomjanovich, Apr 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Mark Berman:Rick Carlisle on the potential of Rudy Tomjanovich being elected into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame:

“Rudy’s one of the great coaches in history. His back-to-back titles and his Olympic championship are huge milestones in his career.”

Rick Carlisle on Rudy Tomjanovich, Jan 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Bill Fitch on Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Fitch on Rudy Tomjanovich not being a finalist:

“I'm sure he'll get in. I gave him his first coaching job. He and Carroll (Dawson) were my assistant. I figure Carroll ought to get both of us in. He'll get in.”

Bill Fitch on Rudy Tomjanovich, Feb 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Ty Lue:

“Rudy Tomjanovich (said) never underestimate the heart of a champion. Until we’re dead in our grave, until Golden State’s dead in their grave, it’s not over.”

Tyronn Lue on Rudy Tomjanovich, May 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni on Rudy Tomjanovich not getting into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame again:

“Shocked, I'm amazed. What does he have to do?.. I don't understand the criteria.. There's nobody in the Hall right now more qualified than him. It's sad.”

Mike D'Antoni on Rudy Tomjanovich, Mar 30, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Dennis Lindsey, Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Morey continues to insist that it was as much Alexander’s ideas as his own.

“From the moment I interviewed here, to the people that were here before, like Dennis Lindsey (now the Jazz GM), and Rudy (Tomjanovich), they’ll tell you this is how he always felt like basketball should be played,”

Daryl Morey on Dennis Lindsey, Rudy Tomjanovich, Jan 9, 2017. Source: NBA.com.
